name: SignRequest
description: SignRequest prepares, sends, and tracks electronic-signature documents.
agentUseSummary: Connect one user through Relay-owned confidential OAuth with exactly SignRequest's read scope. Relay exposes two fixed projections: up to 25 first-page document lifecycle summaries and lifecycle metadata for one explicit UUID. People, teams, files, signing data, audit history, writes, broader authority, raw access, pagination, polling, retries, callbacks, and exports are blocked.

capabilities.label: List documents
capabilities.description: Read one bounded first page of document lifecycle metadata.

capabilities.label: Inspect document metadata
capabilities.description: Read lifecycle metadata for one explicit document UUID.

allowed.label: List document summaries
allowed.description: List up to 25 first-page document lifecycle summaries visible to the connected user.

allowed.label: Inspect a document
allowed.description: Inspect lifecycle metadata for one explicit SignRequest document UUID.

blocked.label: Access private document content
blocked.description: Files, PDF downloads, source URLs, frontend secrets, people, teams, signers, messages, fields, attachments, signing logs, and event history are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or sign documents
blocked.description: Creating, uploading, preparing, sending, signing, sharing, reminding, cancelling, deleting, and changing documents are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broader authority
blocked.description: The write scope, templates, sign requests, teams, members, API tokens, webhooks, integrations, partner impersonation, and administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk APIs
blocked.description: Raw paths, arbitrary filters or queries, search, pagination, polling, automatic retries, batch access, callbacks, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read-only document lifecycle
approvalProfiles.description: Two bounded reads run automatically with exactly SignRequest's read scope; private content, writes, broader authority, raw access, and bulk transfer remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The exact read scope, fixed origin and paths, strict projection, result cap, and read-only boundary remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two bounded document-lifecycle reads and attaches the exact read-scoped token server-side.
Relay mounts two bounded document-lifecycle reads and attaches the exact read-scoped token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's confidential SignRequest OAuth application, production client credentials, and any required partner contact or approval are not configured. No provider-console, credential, consent, Railway, or live acceptance work is authorized in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized owner creates or approves a confidential authorization-code application, configures the exact Railway callback and only the read scope, stores the client ID and secret through Railway's secret process, deploys separately, and runs live connect, list/get redaction, refresh, revoke/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial acceptance.

evidence.supports: SignRequest documents confidential authorization-code OAuth, distinct read and write scopes, refresh tokens, Bearer authentication, and upstream token revocation.
SignRequest documents bounded document listing with limit/page, explicit document retrieval by UUID, and the sensitive file, user, team, signer, and signing fields Relay excludes.
